intro: Gupta Enterprises manufactures precision sheet-metal, tubular and deep-draw components — and the tools and dies that make them. Founded in Faridabad in 2004, we run 35 power presses from 20 to 250 tonnes alongside laser cutting, CNC/VMC machining, fixture welding and a fully equipped in-house tool room. Because tooling, fabrication and inspection all sit under our own roof, quality, cost and lead time stay under our control rather than a supplier's.
positioning: A single-source component partner for automotive OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers — from die design to inspected, dispatch-ready parts.
mission: Deliver components that meet exact specification, on time, every time — controlling quality and cost through in-house tooling and modern machinery.
missionPoints: Deliver components that meet exact specification, on time, every time.
Control quality and cost through in-house tooling and modern machinery.
Build long-term partnerships through responsiveness and integrity.
Grow into new industries and export markets without compromising quality.
vision: To be the manufacturing partner of choice for automotive OEMs in India and abroad — recognised for precision, reliability and engineering excellence.
story: Gupta Enterprises began in 2004 on a modest press shop floor in Faridabad, Haryana, with a single discipline: sheet-metal press work done right. Two decades on, that discipline is still what the business runs on — the machines have multiplied, the standard has not moved.

The turning point came in 2010, when we brought die and fixture design in-house. It is a decision that shaped everything since. When the tooling that forms your part is built and maintained by the same people who run the press, a die revision takes days instead of weeks, and nobody waits on an outside vendor to fix a problem they did not create. Quality, cost and lead time stopped being things we negotiated with suppliers and became things we controlled.

In 2015 we added fibre laser cutting and VMC machining, which extended us from stamped and formed parts into precision-machined components and better tooling. By 2021 annual turnover had crossed ₹20 crore. Today we operate two manufacturing units in Faridabad totalling 1,100 sq. yards, with 35 power presses spanning 20 to 250 tonnes, 15 welding stations, a full tool room and a team of more than 50 people.

We supply sheet-metal, tubular and tooling components to eight-plus OEM and Tier-1 partners across the Indian automotive supply chain — most of them repeat, multi-year customers. That repeat business is the number we watch most closely, because in this industry nobody re-orders out of politeness.

The fundamentals have not changed: 100% inspection before dispatch, 144 kVA of standby power so production never depends on the grid, and tooling we build ourselves. What is changing is reach — we are applying the same capabilities to industrial equipment, electrical, renewable energy, robotics and agriculture, and building the quality documentation that export programmes demand.

values.title: Quality First
values.text: Every part is inspected against customer specification before dispatch — incoming, in-process and final. No exceptions, no sampling shortcuts.

values.title: On-Time Delivery
values.text: Reliable lead times, backed by real press capacity and 144 kVA of standby power that keeps the shop running when the grid does not.

values.title: Engineering Excellence
values.text: In-house tooling and precision machining on every job, so the die that forms your part is designed by people accountable for the part.

values.title: Integrity
values.text: Honest commitments and transparent partnerships. If a date or a tolerance is not achievable, you hear it at quotation — not at delivery.

values.title: Customer Focus
values.text: Responsive support and custom-engineered solutions, with a reply to every enquiry inside one working day.

values.title: Continuous Improvement
values.text: Ongoing investment in people, machines and processes — the reason our capability list is longer every five years.

whyUs.title: Single-source manufacturing
whyUs.text: Cutting, forming, welding, machining and tooling under one roof. One purchase order, one point of accountability, no sub-vendor chain to chase when a date slips.

whyUs.title: Scalable press capacity
whyUs.text: 35 power presses from 20 to 250 tonnes handle prototype batches and high-volume programmes on the same floor — so you are not re-sourcing when volumes ramp.

whyUs.title: Quality you can audit
whyUs.text: 100% of parts checked against your specification before dispatch, with incoming, in-process and final stages documented under an ISO 9001:2015 system.

whyUs.title: Supply you can rely on
whyUs.text: 144 kVA of standby generation (62 + 82 kVA DG sets) keeps presses, lasers and welding lines running through grid outages — a real risk in North Indian industrial belts.

whyUs.title: Tooling we build ourselves
whyUs.text: Dies, fixtures and gauges designed, built and maintained in our own tool room. Revisions and repairs never sit in an outside vendor's queue.

whyUs.title: Customers who re-order
whyUs.text: Eight-plus OEM and Tier-1 partners, most of them multi-year repeat customers. Consistency, not one-off wins, is what the record shows.

process.title: Enquiry & feasibility
process.text: Send drawings in PDF, DWG, DXF or STEP. We review manufacturability, tooling requirements, material availability and volume fit, then come back with a costed quotation — or an honest no.

process.title: Design & in-house tooling
process.text: Our tool room designs and builds the progressive dies, deep-draw tools, weld fixtures and inspection gauges your part needs. Because it happens here, revisions take days.

process.title: Material sourcing
process.text: Raw material is procured against your specification and verified at incoming inspection before it is released to production.

process.title: Fabrication
process.text: Parts are cut, blanked, formed, drawn and machined across the laser, press and CNC/VMC lines — with in-process checks at each transfer.

process.title: Welding & assembly
process.text: Fixture-based MIG and projection welding joins components into finished sub-assemblies with repeatable, hole-to-hole accurate geometry.

process.title: Inspection & dispatch
process.text: Final inspection against your drawing, then packing and dispatch with the documentation your goods-inward team needs.

futureVision.title: New industries
futureVision.text: Applying precision press, tube and machining capability beyond automotive — into industrial equipment, electrical, renewable energy, robotics and agriculture.

futureVision.title: Export ready
futureVision.text: Building the quality systems, documentation and packaging standards international OEMs and buyers require before they place a first order.

futureVision.title: Growing capacity
futureVision.text: Continued investment in machinery, tooling and skilled people so we scale with our customers' programmes rather than capping them.

clientsNote: We supply components to leading Indian automotive parts manufacturers — many of them repeat, multi-year customers.
